text: Some kinds of weather can severely degrade the performance of an aircraft, such as turbulence and mountain waves. Icing conditions can also be very dangerous. Pilots need to know that freezing rain, clouds, or drizzle can cause ice to build up on the critical surfaces of an aircraft. What kind of weather causes severe icing conditions?
